preserve: findSimilarVector and findSimilar answer as before, the package's process scripts run in the same order, and spread keeps its rule

Bound vector-bearing preparation and fact-generation inputs by index_batch_bytes; apply the ordered batches to one ANN state through the original mutation function, query once, and collect selected facts from bounded batches. No ranking, candidate order or descriptor limits change.

With a spread, approximate aggregation retains its existing descriptor result_limit pool before the merge. Exact aggregation instead collects the full qualified canonical pool from the shared scorer, then applies global ranking, spread and the requested final limit. The descriptor result_limit continues to cap direct results and supply an unasked aggregate default; it does not discard exact aggregate candidates.

Descriptor search_mode exact reuses the existing nearest-embedding-facts iterable scorer over every canonical vector-set row, without LSH or whole-vector plan JSON for precomputed matrices. Exact text inputs reuse bounded embedding/fact batches. The default approximate mode, scorer, score floor, total order, canonical qualification, model provenance and existing limits remain intact.

Relocate the existing reader into the common account-wide search owner; retain the prior-owner baseline as history and capture the identical original bytes at the receiving target before the active adaptation. Update only owner-relative imports, supplied paths and current consumer references.
